primary_metric: case mean over two seeds of first10 x 6 motor RMSE versus own same-input same-seed original BF16
unit: fixed observation; two sampler seeds are paired repeats, not independent scenes; Plus variants can share underlying tasks
claim_scope: new held-out observations within familiar tasks and disjoint selected Plus variants; not unseen-task generalization, success rate or native-kernel latency

limitations.seed_unit: two sampler seeds are averaged within each case; cases are descriptive paired observations
limitations.plus_dependence: Plus variants may share underlying tasks; no independent-sample confidence interval or p-value is computed
limitations.action_sensitivity: sampled first-order action projection proxy only; not full final-action sensitivity
